verdict.rationale: Greptile is built to run unattended: it automatically reviews every pull request once GitHub or GitLab is connected and review triggers are set (docs-1, docs-5), with config-as-code via greptile.json (docs-22). Its official CLI runs `greptile review` from the terminal, and coding agents can call it to review their own code (docs-14, docs-15, probe-5). A community user confirms the automated PR reviews work in daily team use (comm-8). Missing for 10: explicit docs for running the CLI inside CI pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions steps), non-interactive token/API-key auth, machine-readable output or exit codes for gating builds, and hands-on corroboration of CLI use in CI.
